notes: *therefrom* fuses the preposition and its suffix under rule 30, headed on the preposition since no relative stands; rule 22's unrepresented reading does not reach a morpheme whose sense the one English word carries.
מִלְּבַד fuses to *besides* under rule 30 across all three morphemes, headed on בַּד.
*burnt it* supplies an object with no object morpheme present, so *it* is `added` under rule 44; the עֹלַת הַבֹּקֶר chain writes two *the*s and is read by rule 29's arthrous case.
